examples.text: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā soṇo rājagahe viharati sītavanasmiṃ. atha kho āyasmato soṇassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi

63103.meaning1: of the cool clouds; (comm) who makes cool clouds

examples.text: katame ca, bhikkhave, valāhakakāyikā devā? santi, bhikkhave, sītavalāhakā devā, santi uṇhavalāhakā devā, santi abbhavalāhakā devā, santi vātavalāhakā devā, santi vassavalāhakā devā, ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, valāhakakāyikā devā'ti.

63104.meaningLit: group of ten discourses on how giving supports (rebirth among the gods living in) cool thunderclouds
63104.sanskrit: śīta + balāhaka + dāna + upakāra + sūkta, sūtra (bsk) + daśaka

63105.meaningLit: discourse on (deities living in) cool clouds

63106.commentary: (UDa) sītavātaduddinī'ti sā ca satt'āhavaddalikā udakaphusitasammissena sītavātena samantato paribbhamantena dusitadivasattā duddinī nāma ahosi.

examples.text: sītavātaparittānaṃ, hirikopīnachādanaṃ, matt'aṭṭhiyaṃ abhuñjiṃsu, santuṭṭhā itarītare.
tena kho pana samayena mahā akālamegho udapādi satt'āhavaddalikā sītavātaduddinī.

63107.meaning1: for protection from cold and wind

examples.text: sītavātaparittāṇaṃ, hirikopīnachādanaṃ. matt'aṭṭhiyaṃ abhuñjiṃsu, santuṭṭhā itar'ītare.

63108.commentary: (SNa) sīt'assa iriyāpatho'ti sītaṃ assa sattakāyassa iriyāpatho jīvitavutti. sītan'ti naṅgalaṃ. yassa hi naṅgalehi khettaṃ appamattakam'pi kaṭṭhaṃ na hoti, so kathaṃ jīvissatī'ti vadati.

examples.text: paññā lokasmi pajjoto, sati lokasmi jāgaro, gāvo kamme sajīvānaṃ, sīt'assa iriyāpatho.

63109.commentary: (ITIa) sītibhavissantī'ti accantavūpasamena saṅkhāra-daratha-paṭippassaddhiyā sītalī bhavissanti, appaṭisandhikanirodhena nirujjhissantī'ti attho.

examples.text: tassa idh'eva, bhikkhave, sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sīti bhavissanti. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, anupādisesā nibbānadhātu. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve nibbānadhātuyo'ti.

63110.meaning1: coolness; calm; peace; epithet of Nibbāna

examples.text: raṇaṃ karitvā kāmānaṃ, sītibhāv'ābhikaṅkhinī, appamattā vihassāmi, sabbasaṃyojanakkhaye.
kāmānañ'c'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, pariññaṃ paññāpemi, rūpānañ'ca pariññaṃ paññāpemi, vedanānañ'ca pariññaṃ paññāpemi, diṭṭh'eva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītibhūto anupādā parinibbānaṃ paññāpemī'ti.
hitvā ratiñ'ca aratiñ'ca, sītibhūtaṃ nirūpadhiṃ, sabbalok'ābhibhuṃ vīraṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

63114.grammar: opt of sītibhavati, comp vb, irreg, intrans
63114.meaning1: could become cool; could be liberated

examples.text: tiṭṭhe ce so tattha anānuyāyī, pūgam'pi vassānaṃ samantacakkhu, tatth'eva so sītisiyā vimutto, cavetha viññāṇaṃ tathāvidhassa.
jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmī'ti pajānāti, kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idh'eva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītī bhavissantī'ti pajānāti.
aññataro naṭapubbako bhikkhu evam'āha, sabbo'yaṃ maññe saṅgho sītīkato'ti.
ayaṃ, bhante, kakudhā nadī avidūre acch'odakā sāt'odakā sīt'odakā set'odakā suppatitthā ramaṇīyā. ettha bhagavā pānīyañ'ca pivissati, gattāni ca sītīkarissatī'ti.

63119.meaning1: becomes cool; grows cold; cools down

examples.text: kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idh'eva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītībhavissantī'ti pajānāti.
so anattan'tapo aparan'tapo diṭṭh'eva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhappaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati, ayam'eva me puggalo cittaṃ ārādhetī'ti.

63121.meaning1: with cold water; with cool water

examples.text: sīt'odakaṃ pokkharaṇiṃ, yuttaṃ kiñjakkhareṇunā, nāgo ghamm'ābhitatto'va, ogāhe te than'ūdaraṃ.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, pokkharaṇī acch'odakā sāt'odakā sīt'odakā setakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā nānārukkhehi sañchannā.

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, idh'assa nigaṇṭho ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno sīt'odakapaṭikkhitto uṇh'odakapaṭisevī. so sīt'odakaṃ alabhamāno kālaṅ'kareyya. imassa pana, gahapati, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto katth'ūpapattiṃ paññapetī'ti?

63123.meaning1: refusing cold water; rejecting cool water
63123.commentary: (MNa) sīt'odakapaṭikkhitto'ti nigaṇṭhā sattasaññāya sīt'odakaṃ paṭikkhipanti. taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, idh'assa nigaṇṭho ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno sīt'odakapaṭikkhitto uṇh'odakapaṭisevī. so sīt'odakaṃ alabhamāno kālaṅ'kareyya. imassa pana, gahapati, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto katth'ūpapattiṃ paññapetī'ti?
kathaṃsu tarati oghaṃ, rattin'divam'atandito, appatiṭṭhe anālambe, ko gambhīre na sīdatī'ti.
āsāya yanti vāṇijā dhan'esino, nāvaṃ samāruyha parenti aṇṇave, te tattha sīdanti atho'pi ekadā, jīnādhanā enti vinaṭṭhapābhatā.
yena sallena otiṇṇo, disā sabbā vidhāvati, tam'eva sallam'abbuyha, na dhāvati na sīdati.

63128.meaning2: bottomless (name for ocean around Mt. Sineru)

63130.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: bodhi mahānāmo atho'pi uttaro, kesī sikhī sundaro dvārabhājo, tissūpatissā bhavabandhanacchidā, upasīdarī taṇhacchido ca sīdarī.

63132.meaning2: having sank, having subsided, having yielded

examples.text: n'āhaṃ sabbe samaṇabrāhmaṇāse, jātijarāya nivutā'ti brūmi, ye s'īdha diṭṭhaṃ'va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, sīlabbataṃ vā'pi pahāya sabbaṃ, anekarūpam'pi pahāya sabbaṃ, taṇhaṃ pariññāya anāsavāse, te ve narā oghatiṇṇā'ti brūmi.

63136.meaning2: situated within or on the boundary

63139.commentary: (SNPa) kiñ'ca bhiyyo so īdiso bhūripañño catunnaṃ kilesasīmānaṃ atītattā sīm'ātigo bāhitapāpattā ca brāhmaṇo

examples.text: sīmā-atigo brāhmaṇo tassa n'atthi, ñatvā va disvā va samuggahītaṃ, na rāgarāgī na virāgaratto, tass'īdha n'atthī param'uggahītan'ti.
evaṃ sabbathā'pi karuṇāyitvā vuttanayen'eva attani piyapuggale majjhatte verimhī'ti catūsu janesu sīmāsambhedaṃ katvā

63140.commentary: (VINa) sīmaṃ sammannatī'ti navaṃ sīmaṃ bandhati. kurundiyaṃ pana udak'ukkhepaparicchindane'pi dukkaṭaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: yattakā bhikkhū tassa uposathakammassa pattā yuttā anurūpā, sabb'antimena paricchedena cattāro bhikkhū pakatattā, saṅghena anukkhitā, te ca kho hatthapāsaṃ avijahitvā ekasīmāyaṃ ṭhitā.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: upasampādessāmī'ti gaṇaṃ vā ācariyaṃ vā pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā pariyesati, sīmaṃ vā sammannati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ. dvīhi kammavācāhi dukkaṭā.

63142.meaning1: crossed the boundary; gone over the limit; epithet of an arahant
63142.commentary: (SNPa) catunnaṃ kilesasīmānaṃ atītattā sīm'ātigo bāhitapāpattā ca brāhmaṇo (NIDD1) sīm'ātigo brāhmaṇo tassa n'atthi, ñatvā ca disvā ca samuggahītan'ti. tassa idaṃ paramaṃ aggaṃ seṭṭhaṃ visiṭṭhaṃ pāmokkhaṃ uttamaṃ pavaran'ti gahitaṃ parāmaṭṭhaṃ abhiniviṭṭhaṃ ajjhositaṃ adhimuttaṃ n'atthi na santi na saṃvijjati n'upalabbhati, pahīnaṃ samucchinnaṃ vūpasantaṃ paṭipassaddhaṃ abhabb'uppattikaṃ ñāṇ'agginā daḍḍhan'ti, sīm'ātigo brāhmaṇo tassa n'atthi ñatvā ca disvā ca samuggahītaṃ.

examples.text: sīm'ātigo brāhmaṇo tassa n'atthi, ñatvā va disvā va samuggahītaṃ, na rāgarāgī na virāgaratto, tass'īdha n'atthī param'uggahītan'ti.
saṅg'ātigo hatamado, tevijjo tibhavantago, sīm'ātigo dhammagaru, gatattho hitavabbhuto.

63144.meaning1: breaking down the barriers; blurring the distinction

examples.text: evaṃ sabbathā'pi karuṇāyitvā vuttanayen'eva attani piyapuggale majjhatte verimhī'ti catūsu janesu sīmāsambhedaṃ katvā
so, duggataṃ durūpetan'ti pāḷiyā na sameti, tasmā vuttanayen'ev'ettha bhāvanam'ārabhitvā sīmāsambhedaṃ katvā appanā vaḍḍhetabbā.

63145.meaning2: fixing of a new boundary, convention of a chapter house

63146.meaning1: ethical conduct; ethics; virtue; moral integrity

examples.text: kacci nu kho me attā sīlato na upavadatī'ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
puna caparaṃ, mahānāma, ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni.

seyyathā'pi, aggivessana, hatthidamako mahantaṃ thambhaṃ pathaviyaṃ nikhaṇitvā āraññakassa nāgassa gīvāyaṃ upanibandhati āraññakānañ'c'eva sīlānaṃ abhinimmadanāya… gām'ante abhiramāpanāya manussakantesu sīlesu samādapanāya.
tasmā hi dhīrañ'ca paññañ'ca bahussutañ'ca, dhorayhasīlaṃ vatavantam'ariyaṃ, taṃ tādisaṃ sappurisaṃ sumedhaṃ, bhajetha nakkhattapathaṃ'va candimā.

63148.meaning1: with a kind of conduct; with a certain behaviour; having a habit

examples.text: yāni ca kho tāni sikkhāpadāni ādibrahmacariyakāni brahmacariyasāruppāni tattha dhuvasīlo ca hoti ṭhitasīlo ca, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
dhīrassa vigatamohassa, pabhinnakhīlassa vijitavijayassa, anīghassa susamacittassa, vuddhasīlassa sādhupaññassa, vesamantarassa vimalassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi

63150.notes: usually seen as plural in this sense

examples.text: upehi saraṇaṃ buddhaṃ, dhammaṃ saṅghañ'ca tādinaṃ, samādiyāhi sīlāni, taṃ te atthāya hehiti.

63152.meaning1: talk on ethical conduct; discussion about correct behaviour
63152.meaning2: exposition of the duties of morality

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā brahm'āyussa brāhmaṇassa anupubbiṃ kathaṃ kathesi, seyyath'idaṃ, dānakathaṃ, sīlakathaṃ, saggakathaṃ, kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.

appicchakathā, santuṭṭhikathā, pavivekakathā, asaṃsaggakathā, vīriy'ārambhakathā, sīlakathā, samādhikathā, paññākathā, vimuttikathā, vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā'ti, imāni kho, bhikkhave, dasa kathāvatthūni.

63153.meaning1: combination of ethical behaviours; virtuous conduct
63153.meaning2: all that belongs to moral practices

examples.text: so iminā ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ anavajjasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
app'eva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan'ti bhikkhubhāvā cāveyyaṃ, samaṇadhammā cāveyyaṃ, sīlakkhandhā cāveyyaṃ, tapoguṇā cāveyyaṃ.

63154.meaning1: category of virtue; group of ethical conduct
63154.meaning2: all that belongs to moral practices

examples.text: tīhi ca kho, āvuso visākha, khandhehi ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo saṅgahito. yā c'āvuso visākha, sammāvācā yo ca sammākamm'anto yo ca sammāājīvo ime dhammā sīlakkhandhe saṅgahitā.

63155.commentary: (DNa) dīgh'āgamo nāma sīlakkhandhavaggo, mahāvaggo, pāthikavaggo'ti vaggato tivaggo hoti, suttato catuttiṃsasuttasaṅgaho. tassa vaggesu sīlakkhandhavaggo ādi, suttesu brahmajālaṃ. brahmajālassā'pi evaṃ me sutan'ti-ādikaṃ āyasmatā ānandena paṭhamamahāsaṅgītikāle vuttaṃ nidānam'ādi.

examples.text: sīlakkhandhavaggo niṭṭhito.

63156.meaningLit: canonical text of the section on virtuous conduct

63157.meaning1: fragrance of virtue; perfume of ethical conduct; sweet smell of morality

examples.text: candanaṃ tagaraṃ vā'pi, uppalaṃ atha vassikī, etesaṃ gandhajātānaṃ, sīlagandho anuttaro.
sīlagandhasamo gandho, kuto nāma bhavissati, yo samaṃ anuvāte ca, paṭivāte ca vāyati.

63158.meaning1: valuing ethical conduct; giving weight to morality

examples.text: katame cattāro? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo na sīlagaru hoti na sīl'ādhipateyyo, na samādhigaru hoti na samādh'ādhipateyyo, na paññāgaru hoti na paññ'ādhipateyyo.

63159.meaning1: the highest ethical conduct; superior virtue

examples.text: katamāni cattāri? sīl'aggaṃ, samādhi'ggaṃ, paññā'ggaṃ, vimutt'aggaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri aggānī'ti.

63161.meaning2: Chapter 3 of the Satipaṭṭhānasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya
63161.meaningLit: section on the presence of ethical conduct

63162.meaning1: with banks of ethical conduct; shored by morality
63162.commentary: (SNa) sīlatittho'ti tassa pana me dhammarahadassa catupārisuddhisīlaṃ titthan'ti dasseti.

examples.text: dhammo rahado brāhmaṇa sīlatittho, anāvilo sabbhi sataṃ pasattho, yattha have vedaguno sinātā, anallagattā'va taranti pāraṃ.

63163.meaning1: full of virtue and insight; ethical and wise
63163.commentary: (DHPa) sīladassanasampannan'ti catupārisuddhisīlena c'eva maggaphalasampayuttena ca sammādassanena sampannaṃ.

examples.text: sīladassanasampannaṃ, dhammaṭṭhaṃ saccavedinaṃ, attano kamma kubbānaṃ, taṃ jano kurute piyaṃ.

63164.meaning1: pair of loss of virtue and view

63165.meaning1: wealth that is ethical behaviour; treasure of conduct

examples.text: saddhādhanaṃ sīladhanaṃ, hirī ottappiyaṃ dhanaṃ, sutadhanañ'ca cāgo ca, paññā ve sattamaṃ dhanaṃ.

63167.meaning1: virtue and wisdom; moral integrity and understanding

examples.text: vuddhippatto'smi muddho mama varagaravo sīlapaññ'ādisobhe, cand'ādicc'eva suddhe varajinaṭhapite sāsanābbhe patīte, nissāyevā tipemā paṇamiya sirasā niccam'esaṃ saritvā, pādambhoje guṇagge hataduritamalo ānubhāvena tassā.

63168.meaning1: discussion of ethical conduct and wisdom

63169.meaning1: characteristic of morality; (comm) ethical conduct and wisdom

examples.text: na hi pana tvaṃ, tāta bhadramukha, tassa bhagavato sīlapaññāṇaṃ jānāsi. sace tvaṃ, tāta bhadramukha, tassa bhagavato sīlapaññāṇaṃ jāneyyāsi, na tvaṃ, tāta bhadramukha, taṃ bhagavantaṃ akkositabbaṃ paribhāsitabbaṃ maññeyyāsī'ti.

63170.meaning1: equipped with ethics; accessorized with virtue

examples.text: ratho sīlaparikkhāro, jhān'akkho cakkavīriyo, upekkhā dhurasamādhi, anicchā parivāraṇaṃ.

63171.meaning1: cleansed by ethical conduct; purified by morality

examples.text: sīlapaññāṇañ'ca pana lokasmiṃ aggam'akkhāyati. seyyathā'pi, brāhmaṇa, hatthena vā hatthaṃ dhoveyya, pādena vā pādaṃ dhoveyya, evam'eva kho, brāhmaṇa, sīlaparidhotā paññā, paññāparidhotaṃ sīlaṃ. yattha sīlaṃ tattha paññā, yattha paññā tattha sīlaṃ.

63172.meaning1: nurtured by good conduct; fortified by ethical integrity; matured by morality

examples.text: yassa kassaci, mahānāma, dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sīlaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sutaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ cāgaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ…

63174.meaning2: highest state of morality; perfection of conduct

63175.meaning1: purification of conduct; cleansing of virtue

examples.text: iti evarūpiṃ sīlapārisuddhiṃ aparipūraṃ vā paripūressāmi paripūraṃ vā tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmī'ti, yo tattha chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañ'ca, idaṃ vuccati, byagghapajjā, sīlapārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgaṃ.

63176.meaning1: factor related to striving for the purification of conduct
63176.commentary: (ANa) sīlapārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgan'ti sīlaparisodhana-vīriyass'etaṃ nāmaṃ. tañ'hi sīlapārisuddhi-paripūraṇ'atthāya padhāniy'aṅgan'ti sīlapārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgaṃ. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: iti evarūpiṃ sīlapārisuddhiṃ aparipūraṃ vā paripūressāmi paripūraṃ vā tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmī'ti, yo tattha chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañ'ca, idaṃ vuccati, byagghapajjā, sīlapārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgaṃ.

63177.meaningLit: for the sake of fulfilling purity of conduct
63177.construction:
sīla + pārisuddhi + paripūraṇa + attha + āya
sīlapārisuddhiparipūraṇattha + āya

63178.commentary: (SNa) rūpabalan'tiādīsu rūpasampatti rūpabalaṃ, bhogasampatti bhogabalaṃ, ñātisampatti ñātibalaṃ, puttasampatti puttabalaṃ, sīlasampatti sīlabalaṃ. pañcasīladasasīlāni akhaṇḍāni katvā rakkhantassa hi sīlasampatti'y'eva sīlabalaṃ nāma hoti.

examples.text: katamāni pañca? rūpabalaṃ, bhogabalaṃ, ñātibalaṃ, puttabalaṃ, sīlabalaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca mātugāmassa balāni. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi balehi samannāgato mātugāmo visārado agāraṃ ajjhāvasatī'ti.

63179.meaning1: because of the power of morality

examples.text: na, bhikkhave, mātugāmo rūpabalahetu vā bhogabalahetu vā ñātibalahetu vā puttabalahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. sīlabalahetu kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.

63180.meaning1: precepts and practices; ethics and observances; rites and rituals

examples.text: mosavajje na nīyetha, sampajāno saṭhāni na kayirā, atha jīvitena paññāya, sīlabbatena n'āññam'atimaññe.

ye kec'ime samaṇabrāhmaṇāse, diṭṭhassuten'āpi vadanti suddhiṃ, sīlabbaten'āpi vadanti suddhiṃ, anekarūpena vadanti suddhiṃ, kacci'ssu te bhagavā tattha yatā carantā, atāru jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisa, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.

63181.meaning1: clinging to precepts and practices; adherence to rites and rituals (as a means of liberation)

examples.text: tassa evaṃ yoniso manasikaroto tīṇi saṃyojanāni pahīyanti, sakkāyadiṭṭhi, vicikicchā, sīlabbataparāmāso. ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, āsavā dassanā pahātabbā
sakkāyadiṭṭhi, vicikicchā, sīlabbataparāmāso, kāmacchando, byāpādo, imāni pañc'oram'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.

63182.meaning1: obsessed by clinging to precepts and practices; consumed by adherence to rites and rituals

examples.text: sīlabbataparāmāsa-pariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati sīlabbataparāmāsaparetena, uppannassa ca sīlabbataparāmāsassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. tassa so sīlabbataparāmāso thāmagato appaṭivinīto oram'bhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ.

63183.meaning1: afflicted with clinging to precepts and practices; filled with adherence to rites and rituals

examples.text: sīlabbataparāmāsa-pariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati sīlabbataparāmāsaparetena, uppannassa ca sīlabbataparāmāsassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. tassa so sīlabbataparāmāso thāmagato appaṭivinīto oram'bhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ.

63184.meaning1: underlying tendency to cling to precepts and practices; propensity to adhere to rites and rituals

examples.text: daharassa hi, mālukyaputta, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa sīlā'ti'pi na hoti, kuto pan'assa uppajjissati sīlesu sīlabbataparāmāso? anusetv'ev'assa sīlabbataparāmās'ānusayo.

63185.meaning1: consummate in precepts and practices; accomplished in ethics and observances

examples.text: yo sīlabbatasampanno, pahit'atto samāhito, cittaṃ yassa vasībhūtaṃ, ek'aggaṃ susamāhitaṃ.

63187.meaning1: grasping precepts and practices; clinging to ethics and observances; adherence to rites and rituals

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, upādānaṃ? cattār'imāni, bhikkhave, upādānāni, kām'upādānaṃ, diṭṭh'upādānaṃ, sīlabbat'upādānaṃ, attavād'upādānaṃ. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, upādānaṃ.

te na sammā sabb'upādānapariññaṃ paññapenti, kām'upādānassa pariññaṃ paññapenti, na diṭṭh'upādānassa pariññaṃ paññapenti, na sīlabbat'upādānassa pariññaṃ paññapenti, na attavād'upādānassa pariññaṃ paññapenti.

63188.meaning1: ethical failure; loss of virtue; disastrous morality

examples.text: ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, bhogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, rogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, sīlabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, diṭṭhibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa

63189.meaning1: because of loss of virtue; due to ethical failure

examples.text: n'āvuso, sattā ñātibyasanahetu vā bhogabyasanahetu vā rogabyasanahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti. sīlabyasanahetu vā, āvuso, sattā diṭṭhibyasanahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.

63191.meaning1: merely regarding ethics; about mere morality

examples.text: appamattakaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, bhikkhave, oramattakaṃ sīlamattakaṃ, yena puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.

63192.meaning1: defined by ethical behaviour; identified with morality
63192.meaning2: made by morality; produced by behaviour
63192.commentary: (MNa) no ca sīlamayo'ti alam'ettāvatā, n'atthi ito kiñci uttari karaṇīyan'ti evaṃ sīlamayo na hoti.

examples.text: idha, thapati, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti no ca sīlamayo, tañ'ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, yatth'assa te kusalā sīlā aparisesā nirujjhanti.

63193.meaning1: undertaking ethical precepts; taking up morality
63193.commentary: (DNa) sīlasamādāne'ti pañcasīla-dasasīla-catupārisuddhisīla-pūraṇakāle. (DNt) sīlasamādāne'ti sīlassa samma'd'eva ādāne, gahaṇe pavattane'ti attho. taṃ pavattikālena dassento pūraṇakāle'ti āha.

examples.text: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno daḷhasamādāno ahosi kusalesu dhammesu, avatthitasamādāno kāyasucarite vacīsucarite manosucarite dānasaṃvibhāge sīlasamādāne uposath'upavāse matteyyatāya petteyyatāya sāmaññatāya brahmaññatāya kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyitāya aññatar'aññataresu ca adhikusalesu dhammesu.

63195.meaning1: ethical conduct, meditative composure and understanding
63195.compound: dvanda (sīla ca samādhi ca paññā ca)

63196.meaning1: successful attainment of ethical conduct, meditative composure and understanding
63196.meaning2: successful attainment of ethical conduct, stability of mind and understanding

63197.meaning1: moral conduct, meditative composure and insight

63198.meaning1: moral conduct, meditative composure, insight, path, fruition and Nibbāna

63199.meaning1: who has virtue; who has integrity

examples.text: dukkaraṃ vā'pi karonti, sekhā sīlasamāhitā, ṭhitattā anagāriy'upetassa, tuṭṭhi hoti sukh'āvahā'ti.
yaṃ ce viññū pasaṃsanti, anuvicca suve suve, acchiddavuttiṃ medhāviṃ, paññāsīlasamāhitaṃ.
